scientific_integrity: The infinite classification is proved symbolically from the exact unitary-divisor-sum formula, Das's necessary abundance condition, monotone rational inequalities, and explicit equal-sum partitions. The finite checker is only a regression test.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats even unitary Zumkeller numbers with exactly three distinct prime factors. It does not settle the conjecture for support size four or larger and makes no claim about the number of partitions.
title: Three-prime-support classification of even unitary Zumkeller numbers
